CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:30 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

August 8, 2023

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M.

B. ROLL CALL:

Present:
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Absent:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

All items listed under Consent Calendar are considered by the Design Review Board to
be routine and will be enacted by one motion unless a citizen or Board Member requests
otherwise; in which case, the item will be removed for separate consideration.

ITEM 1:  1910 West Main Street

Item 1 from the August 8, 2023 meeting is pulled to the Discussion Items by
Michael Daninger.

MOTION:
  • Daninger moved to pull Item 1.
  • Tsai seconded.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 1:  1910 West Main Street

  1
   •  This is an application for four (4) commercial exterior sign improvements on an
  existing one-story commercial bank building. The proposed updates to signage
  are integrated with the design of the building. The proposed signage is similar in
  size, scale, and placement as previously located.
  •  Applicant: Pattison Sign Group
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - Recommendation is for approval as
  submitted.
  •  Discussion: Applicant was absent. Staff continued the discussion. Board Member
  Daninger stated that the drawings describe the use of a backer panel, yet the
  elevations do not show any indication of a proposed backer panel.
  Board Member Tsai continued by adding there needs to be further clarification if
  an existing backer panel is being removed and if the applicant is proposing a new
  backer panel in addition to the new channel letterings or if there is no backer
  panel and it is only channel letterings being proposed.
  Vice Chairman Hernandez agreed with the other board member comments and
  stated the applicant shall clarify if a backer panel is proposed and ensure the
  elevations are graphically accurate.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Tsai moved to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The applicant must revise the drawing set to provide clariﬁcation in
  the scope of work to state if proposal is to install new channel letterings on an
  existing backer panel; or install new channel letterings on a new backer panel; 2)
  The applicant shall provide consistency in the drawings throughout, such as
  showing accurate elevation and/or renderings of the proposed channel lettering
  and backer panel with dimensions, color, and font style; and 3) City Architect is
  responsible to verify and approve the revised scope of work, elevations, and
  renderings.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani

ITEM 2:  3124 Front Street

  •  This is an application for new exterior improvements and an addition to an
  existing single-family residence. The proposed project also includes construction
  of an attached ADU to the rear of the existing residence.
  •  Applicant: Vivi Wang (ARC Design and Consulting LLC)
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with Conditions of Approval.
  •  Discussion: Applicant was present. Board Member Tsai stated that the window
  style for the living room window is not consistent with the other window style, in
  terms of grid pattern and proportion, along the front elevation facing Front Street.
  Vice Chairman Hernandez seconded Tsai’s comment and stated that the living
  room window and overall façade needs refinement in architectural detailing and
  elevation fenestration.

  2
   Board Member Daninger agreed with the other board member comments and
  added that the applicant should revise the drafting in the drawings to show
  accurate roof slopes because it does not reflect what is existing based on google
  map street view.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Tsai moved to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The applicant shall revise all proposed window grid patterns
  throughout to be consistent in proportion and scale; 2) The applicant shall revise
  the window type and scale for Window #6, as listed in the window schedule, to
  be appropriate for Bedroom 3 which is shown as an existing bedroom to remain.
  The applicant should consider reducing the window size, provide a casement
  window with similar grid system shown throughout the project, and provide
  additional architectural elements to the North Elevation façade, such as the use
  of window shutters; 3) The applicant must address the drafting errors, such as
  existing and proposed column width and roof line be accurately depicted on the
  drawing set; and 4) City Architect is responsible to verify and approve the revised
  drawing set.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani

ITEM 3:  1201 East Valley Boulevard

  •  This is an application for new exterior improvements and interior remodel of an
  existing single-story commercial fast-food Wendy’s restaurant.
  •  Applicant: Irfan Boukai, Coastline Design & Construction Inc
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with Conditions of Approval.
  •  Discussion: Applicant was absent. Staff continued the discussion. Board Member
  Daninger agreed with City Staff’s recommendations to clarify exterior finishes
  and colors being proposed on the project and remove any that are not. Board
  Member Tsia seconded. Vice Chairman Hernandez Third.

MOTION:

  •  Vice Chairman Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The applicant shall revise the drawing set in responds to City staﬀ’s
  recommended action of approval with conditions; 2) The applicant shall revise
  the Exterior Finishes Legend to accurately depict the exterior materials and
  ﬁnishes being proposed and called-out on the Exterior Elevations and colored
  elevations; 3) The applicant shall revise the Material Board to only show the
  existing and proposed material, color, and ﬁnishes being proposed on the
  project. For instance, materials ‘PEX-8’, ‘PEX-10’, ‘M-1’, and ‘M-4’ are not called-
  out in the drawing set. Remove any materials and ﬁnishes from the material
  board that are not being proposed; 4) Clarify and idenfy the paint color proposed
  for ‘M-2 CORRUGATED METAL PANEL’. Please note this on the drawings,

  3
   Exterior Finishes Legend, and Material Board; and 5) City Architect is
  responsible to verify and approve the revised elevations, color elevations, and
  material board.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani

E. ADJOURNMENT:

  •  We will adjourn to the next meeting on August 8, 2023.

MOTION:

  •  Vice Chair Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:30 P.M.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani

ATTEST:

_____________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
